hypotheses: the definition on the 1b page: C_1b is the largest constant with sup_{x in [-2,2]} ∫_{-1}^{1} f(t) g(x+t) dt >= C_1b for all f, g: [-1,1] → [0,1] with f + g = 1 and ∫ f = 1 (extended by zero), so one admissible f gives C_1b <= its overlap with g = 1 − f (read)

the translation of [-1, 1] to [0, 2] leaves the supremum unchanged, and for equal steps the overlap is piecewise linear in x with knots on the grid, so the supremum is attained at a grid shift (read; relied on by the decider)
